title: rag-hybrid web UI
brief: Redesign the rag-hybrid chat web UI (Go binary, embedded single file): chat with grounded answers and rerank-scored sources, upload .md/.txt/.rst/.pdf, forget by source, health badge, deterministic not-in-corpus state. All functionality of the current app must remain represented.

artboards.title: Engineering console
artboards.tradeoff: Dense, terminal-grade credibility that matches the Go identity; colder and less approachable for non-technical viewers

artboards.title: Document workbench
artboards.tradeoff: Document lifecycle is first-class (sidebar with per-file forget and dropzone); chat loses width and the chrome is heavier

artboards.title: Editorial reader
artboards.tradeoff: Best reading experience and portfolio elegance (serif answers, endnote sources); management features hide behind the ⋯ menu, less discoverable
